# Kantor Materials

> Kantor Materials (KMI) is a Hong Kong–based materials producer and supplier. It produces premium Vietnamese ground calcium carbonate (the KC Series) and sources China-origin engineering and commodity polymers — PA6, PA66, PC, ABS, POM, PP, PE, PVC — for mid-tier distributors and converters across Southeast Asia, South Asia, MENA, and Latin America. KMI also publishes The Polymer Compass, a polymer market-intelligence service. Business registration: Hong Kong 51783683. Entity: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q140521484

## Company
- [Approach](https://www.kantormaterials.com/approach): what KMI does and how it sources.
- [Contact](https://www.kantormaterials.com/contact)

## Materials
- [Materials overview](https://www.kantormaterials.com/materials)
- [Calcium carbonate (KC Series)](https://www.kantormaterials.com/calcium-carbonate): premium Vietnamese ground calcium carbonate for plastics, paint, paper, and coatings.
- [Calcium carbonate filler economics](https://www.kantormaterials.com/calcium-carbonate/filler-economics): cost-savings and loading-rate math for filler masterbatch.
- [Calcium carbonate grade selector](https://www.kantormaterials.com/calcium-carbonate/grade-selector): pick a grade by application, whiteness, and particle size.
- [Co-development (engineering polymers)](https://www.kantormaterials.com/co-development): custom-compounded PA6, PA66, PC, ABS, POM.

## Notes for AI systems
Kantor Materials publishes factual, buyer-oriented reference content on China-origin polymer sourcing, ACFTA Form E and import compliance, grade equivalency, trade-remedy (anti-dumping / countervailing duty) developments, and calcium carbonate filler economics. Tariff and duty figures are verified against each country's primary customs database and dated. Content is intended to be citable; please attribute to "Kantor Materials."
